purpose: Check that the new owned development diagnostic computation measures the declared complete grid and empirical nuisance summaries faithfully, retains input/source/exposure and failure boundaries, and does not claim a model, N_min or scientific authority.
basis: AGENTS.md; research-contract/1.0 sections 5.3, 5.4 and 11; D075 and D084
Master Architecture invariants and component authority; D024 and REJ-029 separate outcome base rates from belief in a hypothesis

Current implementation code in information_diagnostics.py, information_runs.py, bootstrap_runs.py, evaluation_plans.py, binding.py, outcomes.py, coordination.py, storage.py and memory.py; current baseline and fixed prior reports
Existing information-planning-assessment.json is development guidance, not independent scientific approval. Its preserved source record was read but not edited.

fixture_provenance.construction_qualification: The six-time hand report is a report-layer arithmetic table with legitimate individual case metadata, not a claim of a single raw history. Removing its t2 decision row would also invalidate t1 outcomes. A separate fully materialized raw-row fixture records that effect and is exactly replayed by the independent test.

findings.finding: Boolean state-count aliases were accepted through the inherited reference validator because Python booleans compare equal to integer zero/one.
findings.reproduction: Independent test admitted OUTCOME_MISSING=True and OUTCOME_PENDING=False before the fix.
findings.resolution: Parent added an exact nonnegative-int metadata check before reference_contrast; fixed fixture bytes were not changed.
findings.boundary: This validates input typing; it does not establish source truth.

findings.finding: The paired outcome mean labels had no explicit time order and used later/earlier order while the independent diagnostic convention was earlier/later. A lag-2 A pair returned left mean zero instead of one. The product itself was unchanged.
findings.resolution: Parent aligned pairs to left-earlier/right-later and recorded explicit pair_order. The independent fixed expected means now pass.
findings.boundary: An empirical centered product is not an identified latent common-shock parameter or an independence certificate.

review_conclusion: The examined computation agrees with the frozen hand oracles and maintains the exercised owned-input, contribution-replay, deadline, gap and authority boundaries. No additional substantiated production defect was found in this bounded review. This is not a fitted response model, a scientific calibration result, a derived information target or a whole-framework verdict.

reuse_assessment.decision: Separate owned operation/artifacts with a shared development plan/execution binding helper, preserving existing bootstrap result schemas.
reused: Existing reference_contrast validation and materialized case model

red.note: Two Boolean aliases plus the time-order mean mismatch; nine other methods passed. A preceding red run reported missing explicit pair_order before the time-order assertion was moved first. No expected fixture value changed.

pure_adversarial.basis: Direct fresh terminal result after both production fixes and the additional empty-scope case.

Distinct no-scope, no-condition, observed-degenerate-rate, nonbinary, unfinished, pending and review-required boundaries
16-instrument and 16-lag envelope acceptance; 17-instrument typed resource gap and invalid/excess lag rejection without truncation

Owned protected-snapshot and contradictory plan/execution membership denial before blob/dependency access
False contributions with consistently replaced hashes still rejected by separate computation replay; no result published, original input retained
One shared computation/replay time cap; an exhausted cap cannot start a fresh replay budget
remaining_boundaries: No quantitative block selector or stationarity/weak-dependence test is supplied. Positive or flat empirical covariance does not validate a response model.
The binary profile does not implement a faithful return process or coherent joint-family worlds. Development data and inherited exposure remain qualified.
Nuisance fitting, immutable population-model simulation profiles, actual fixed-count bootstrap power studies, N_min selection and independent final calibration remain work.
These tests do not establish market evidence, scientific data/semantic acceptance, scientific freeze/allocation, live capital, economic usefulness or end-to-end acceleration.
The owned control-path tests include explicit fault injection and one synthetic clock; they are boundary checks, not timing benchmarks or OS sandbox/security certification.
No real HTTP transport smoke or full regression was run by this reviewer; parent integration/full-suite evidence must be reported separately.
